```artifact
## Use-Cases & User Stories

**User Story 1:** As a patient residing within the zone, I want to register and apply for appointments/consultation requests.

**User Story 2:** As an authorized chemist, I want to receive prescription requests, deliver medicines, collect payments, and mark prescriptions as completed.

**User Story 3:** As a patient, I want to receive my medicines through offline delivery and pay for them.

**User Story 4:** As a patient, I want to be able to track the status of my prescription delivery.

**User Story 5:** As an authorized laboratory, I want to receive and process prescription requests.

**User Story 6:** As a patient, I want to be able to access my medical records.

**User Story 7:** As a patient, I want to be able to communicate with the healthcare providers through a secure messaging system.

**User Story 8:** As a patient, I want to be able to pay for my appointments/consultation requests using a variety of payment methods.

**User Story 9:** As a patient, I want to be able to provide feedback on the services provided.

**User Story 10:** As a patient, I want to be able to access information about the healthcare providers in the zone.
```
